## Personality

Martin is considered an unreliable individual. He is tasked with looking after a significant amount of stock, though his dependability in managing this responsibility is viewed with doubt.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_

## History

Martin Crawford was engaged to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) when she was seventeen years old. He was later hired on at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where he worked for a year. During his employment at the farm, four cows died under his care.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## Relationships

### [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/martin--rosemary-west.md)

[Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) is Martin's former fiancée, though their romantic engagement ended by Volume 5. Their past commitment was complicated by external factors, including a childhood vow [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) had previously made to her sister [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) never to marry. Though they were once bound to be wed, the relationship ultimately dissolved.
